content: {"summary":"Customers frequently report damaged or defective items, prompting requests for replacements or refunds, as seen in tk_2855191 and tk_2352234. Delivery delays and failed delivery attempts frustrate users, highlighted by tk_136891 and tk_2683536. Issues with payment authorization and unauthorized charges cause additional complaints, such as tk_2945485. Problems with regional courier services, especially in Canarias, lead to returned packages and safety concerns, noted in tk_2475966. Overall, the feedback indicates a need for improved quality control, clearer delivery communication, and streamlined refund processes.
